slides.sub: A missing dash just cost you a buyer.
slides.alt: Night-time buyer holding a sticky note with a part number while her search shows no results and a competitor's site glows behind her.

slides.headline: She types ball valve.
slides.body: Your catalog says BV-050-BR. Add the words buyers type, plus old part numbers.
slides.alt: Brass valve pulled between buyer words and internal catalog codes.

slides.headline: Specs trapped in a PDF.
slides.body: A buyer on a phone will not pinch a 14-page datasheet. Move top specs into fields.
slides.alt: Buyer on a phone blocked by a giant chained PDF tablet.

slides.headline: A fast wrong answer hurts.
slides.body: Site says in stock. Warehouse says no. Trust drops. Match prices and stock to your ERP.
slides.alt: Shop-window display full of stock in front of an empty warehouse.

slides.headline: Answer to quote, one place.
slides.body: Every retyped part number loses buyers. Let her ask, add and request a quote together.
slides.alt: Buyer at a broken bridge between an answer and a quote.

slides.headline: Fix the catalog. Then the chat.
slides.body: The full guide has all seven checks. Run check 1 on your top five parts today.
slides.alt: Organised night warehouse with a glowing assistant beside a clean catalog.
